plan_id.description: The plan this store is on. Its values apply to every key the store does not override.

history.description: Present when reading a single job.

progress.description: Percentage of completion the runner reported.

result_ref.description: Where the artifact is; absent once retention lapses.

reason.description: Why the work is no longer wanted.

default_locale.description: Canonical BCP 47 tag, such as pt-BR.

home_region.description: Region whose cells may host the store.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, such as America/Sao_Paulo.

endpoint.description: Absolute https URL that receives the deliveries.

body.description: Text with {{snake_case}} placeholders; nothing else is interpreted.

category.description: Marketing deliveries are blocked until DEC-PRIV-003 defines consent.

history.description: Present when reading a single delivery.

location.description: Where the error occurred, such as body.name or query.limit.

permissions.description: Permissions granted directly, for what no role covers.

reach.description: How far an organization membership reaches: its node (default), every store, or the listed ones.

reach_stores.description: Stores reached, for a listed reach.

roles.description: Default or custom roles of this node.

subject.description: Subject of the user at the identity provider.

status.description: Always ok while the process can serve requests.

variables.description: Placeholders the text uses; every delivery must supply them.

duration.description: A Go duration, such as 30s or 24h.

request_id.description: Request identifier for support and tracing.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

status.description: ready when every dependency is up.

reason.description: Justification, recorded in the audit trail. Required to disable or uninstall.

recipient.description: The address on the channel. Never echoed back in full.

variables.description: One value per placeholder of the template.

builtin.description: A default role, derived from the catalogue; it cannot be changed or deleted, only cloned.

reason.description: Why this store differs from its plan.

cell_id.description: Present once the store is placed.

kill_switch.description: True when the platform disabled the module for every store.

retention_until.description: Data of an uninstalled module is kept until this instant.

secret.description: Returned once, on creation. Store it: it is never shown again.

bearer.description: Access token from the approved OpenID Connect provider.
